)


def _copy_to_clipboard(text: str) -> None:
    """Copy text to the system clipboard via pbcopy/clip/xclip."""
    system = platform.system()
    if system == "Darwin":
        cmd = ["pbcopy"]
    elif system == "Windows":
        cmd = ["clip"]
    else:
        cmd = ["xclip", "-selection", "clipboard"]
    try:
        subprocess.run(cmd, input=text.encode("utf-8"), check=True)
    except Exception:
        pass


class ColumnNames(list[str]):
    """A list of column names with helper compatibility attributes like .name and .tolist()."""

    @property
    def name(self) -> None:
        return None

    def tolist(self) -> list[str]:
        return list(self)

    def to_list(self) -> list[str]:
        return list(self)

    def get_indexer_for(self, target: Any) -> Any:
        try:
            import pandas as pd

            return pd.Index(self).get_indexer_for(target)
        except Exception:
            return [self.index(x) if x in self else -1 for x in target]

    def _get_level_values(self, i: int) -> Any:
        import pandas as pd

        return pd.Index(self)


class _IlocIndexer:
    """Row/column indexer for compatibility with Pandas iloc syntax."""

    def __init__(self, df: DataFrame):
        self._df = df

    def __getitem__(self, item: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(item, int):
            row_dict = self._df._df.row(item, named=True)
            import pandas as pd

            return pd.Series(row_dict)
        elif isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 2:
            row_idx, col_idx = item
            if isinstance(col_idx, int):
                col_name = self._df._df.columns[col_idx]
                return self._df._df[row_idx, col_name]
            elif isinstance(col_idx, str):
                return self._df._df[row_idx, col_idx]
        return self._df._df[item]

    def __setitem__(self, item: Any, value: Any) -> None:
        if isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 2:
            row_idx, col_idx = item
            if isinstance(col_idx, int):
                col_name = self._df._df.columns[col_idx]
            else:
                col_name = str(col_idx)
            s_list = self._df._df[col_name].to_list()
            s_list[row_idx] = value
            self._df._df = self._df._df.with_columns(pl.Series(col_name, s_list))


class _LocIndexer:
    """Row/column label-based indexer for compatibility with Pandas loc syntax."""

    def __init__(self, df: DataFrame):
        self._df = df

    def __getitem__(self, item: Any) -> Any:
        import polars as pl

        if isinstance(item, tuple):
            rows = item[0]
            if isinstance(rows, pl.Series):
                rows = rows.to_pandas()
            item = (rows, *item[1:])
        elif isinstance(item, pl.Series):
            item = item.to_pandas()
        return self._df.to_pandas().loc[item]


if not hasattr(pl.Series, "iloc"):
    pl.Series.iloc = property(lambda self: self)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
if not hasattr(pl.Series, "isna"):
    pl.Series.isna = lambda self: self.is_null()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
if not hasattr(pl.Series, "isnull"):
    pl.Series.isnull = lambda self: self.is_null()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
if not hasattr(pl.Series, "tolist"):
    pl.Series.tolist = pl.Series.to_list  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

_orig_datatype_eq = pl.DataType.__eq__


def _compat_datatype_eq(self: pl.DataType, other: Any) -> bool:
    if _orig_datatype_eq(self, other):
        return True
    if isinstance(other, str):
        name = self.__class__.__name__.lower()
        other_clean = other.lower().replace("dtype", "")
        return other_clean in (name, f"pl.{name}")
    return False


pl.DataType.__eq__ = _compat_datatype_eq


class DataFrame:
    """High-performance tabular data frame powered by Polars, exposing Pytae's fluent grammar."""

    def __init__(self, data: Any = None, orig_col_map: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
        self._orig_col_map: dict[str, Any] = dict(orig_col_map) if orig_col_map else {}
        self._col_collisions: set[str] = set()
        self._orig_index: list[Any] | None = list(data.index) if hasattr(data, "index") else None

        def _detect_collisions(pdf: Any) -> set[str]:
            collisions = set()
            for col in pdf.columns:
                if pdf[col].dtype == object:
                    vals = pdf[col].tolist()
                    import pandas as pd

                    str_vals = ["nan" if pd.isna(x) else str(x) for x in vals]
                    if len(set(vals)) != len(set(str_vals)):
                        collisions.add(str(col))
            return collisions

        if isinstance(data, (pl.DataFrame, pl.LazyFrame)):
            self._df = data
        elif isinstance(data, DataFrame):
            self._df = data._df
            if not self._orig_col_map:
                self._orig_col_map = dict(data._orig_col_map)
            self._col_collisions = set(data._col_collisions)
            self._orig_index = data._orig_index
        elif isinstance(data, GroupedDataFrame):
            self._df = data._df
            self._orig_index = data._orig_index
        elif hasattr(data, "to_pandas") and not isinstance(data, (str, Path)):
            try:
                import pandas as pd

                if isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame):
                    self._orig_col_map = {str(c): c for c in data.columns}
                    self._col_collisions = _detect_collisions(data)
                    self._orig_index = list(data.index)
                    try:
                        self._df = pl.from_pandas(data)
                    except Exception:
                        df_c = data.copy()
                        for col in df_c.columns:
                            if df_c[col].dtype == object:
                                df_c[col] = df_c[col].astype(str)
                        self._df = pl.from_pandas(df_c)
                else:
                    pdf = data.to_pandas()
                    self._orig_col_map = {str(c): c for c in pdf.columns}
                    self._col_collisions = _detect_collisions(pdf)
                    self._orig_index = list(pdf.index)
                    try:
                        self._df = pl.from_pandas(pdf)
                    except Exception:
                        df_c = pdf.copy()
                        for col in df_c.columns:
                            if df_c[col].dtype == object:
                                df_c[col] = df_c[col].astype(str)
                        self._df = pl.from_pandas(df_c)
            except Exception:
                self._df = pl.DataFrame(data)
        elif data is None:
            self._df = pl.DataFrame()
        else:
            try:
                import pandas as pd

                if isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame):
                    self._orig_col_map = {str(c): c for c in data.columns}
                    self._col_collisions = _detect_collisions(data)
                    self._orig_index = list(data.index)
                    try:
                        self._df = pl.from_pandas(data)
                    except Exception:
                        df_c = data.copy()
                        for col in df_c.columns:
                            if df_c[col].dtype == object:
                                df_c[col] = df_c[col].astype(str)
                        self._df = pl.from_pandas(df_c)
                else:
                    self._df = pl.DataFrame(data)
            except Exception:
                self._df = pl.DataFrame(data)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Core Properties & Representation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    @property
    def pt(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Allow fluid chaining whether or not .pt is repeated."""
        return self

    @property
    def is_lazy(self) -> bool:
        """Return True if this DataFrame is backed by a lazy Polars execution plan."""
        return isinstance(self._df, pl.LazyFrame)

    def lazy(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Convert eager DataFrame to a lazy execution plan."""
        if isinstance(self._df, pl.LazyFrame):
            return self
        return DataFrame(self._df.lazy(), orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)

    def collect(self, **kwargs: Any) -> DataFrame:
        """Execute the lazy plan and materialize into an eager DataFrame."""
        if isinstance(self._df, pl.LazyFrame):
            return DataFrame(self._df.collect(**kwargs), orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)
        return self

    def explain(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
        """Return the unoptimized or optimized physical plan as a string."""
        if isinstance(self._df, pl.LazyFrame):
            return self._df.explain(*args, **kwargs)
        return self._df.lazy().explain(*args, **kwargs)

    @property
    def attrs(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Custom metadata attribute dictionary."""
        return {}

    @property
    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        if self.is_lazy:
            n_rows = self._df.select(pl.len()).collect().item()
            n_cols = len(self._df.collect_schema().names())
            return (n_rows, n_cols)
        return self._df.shape

    @property
    def columns(self) -> ColumnNames:
        cols = self._df.collect_schema().names() if self.is_lazy else self._df.columns
        if self._orig_col_map:
            return ColumnNames([self._orig_col_map.get(c, c) for c in cols])
        return ColumnNames(cols)

    @property
    def dtypes(self) -> list[pl.DataType]:
        if self.is_lazy:
            return list(self._df.collect_schema().values())
        return list(self._df.dtypes)

    @property
    def schema(self) -> pl.Schema:
        if self.is_lazy:
            return self._df.collect_schema()
        return self._df.schema

    @property
    def index(self) -> Any:
        return self._orig_index if self._orig_index is not None else range(len(self))

    @property
    def iloc(self) -> _IlocIndexer:
        return _IlocIndexer(self)

    @property
    def loc(self) -> _LocIndexer:
        return _LocIndexer(self)

    def copy(self, deep: bool = True) -> DataFrame:
        df = DataFrame(self._df.clone(), orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)
        df._orig_index = list(self._orig_index) if self._orig_index is not None else None
        df._col_collisions = set(self._col_collisions)
        return df

    def clone(self) -> DataFrame:
        return self.copy()

    def equals(self, other: Any) -> bool:
        if isinstance(other, DataFrame):
            return self._df.equals(other._df)
        try:
            return self.to_pandas().equals(other)
        except Exception:
            return False

    @property
    def values(self) -> Any:
        return self._df.to_numpy()

    def to_numpy(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        return self._df.to_numpy(*args, **kwargs)

    def select_dtypes(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> DataFrame:
        """Filter columns based on data types."""
        from pytae.select import _matches_dtype

        include = kwargs.get("include", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else None)
        exclude = kwargs.get("exclude", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else None)
        matched = list(self.columns)
        schema = self._df.schema
        if include is not None:
            matched = [c for c in matched if _matches_dtype(schema[c], include)]
        if exclude is not None:
            matched = [c for c in matched if not _matches_dtype(schema[c], exclude)]
        return self.select(*matched)

    def safe_reset_index(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Polars DataFrames have no index; returns self."""
        return self

    def isna(self) -> Any:
        """Check for missing values, delegating to Pandas for 100% API compatibility."""
        return self.to_pandas().isna()

    def isnull(self) -> Any:
        """Alias for isna()."""
        return self.to_pandas().isnull()

    def sort_values(
        self,
        by: Any = None,
        ascending: bool = True,
        na_position: str = "last",
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Pandas-compatible sort_values, delegating to Polars sort."""
        descending = not ascending if isinstance(ascending, bool) else [not a for a in ascending]
        nulls_last = na_position == "last"
        by_cols = [by] if isinstance(by, str) else list(by)
        return DataFrame(self._df.sort(by_cols, descending=descending, nulls_last=nulls_last))

    def query(self, *conditions: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> DataFrame:
        """Pandas-compatible query(), delegating to Pytae filter()."""
        return self.filter(*conditions, **kwargs)

    def slice_max(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        raise AttributeError("df.pt.slice_max() has been removed; use df.pt.pick() instead")

    def slice_min(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        raise AttributeError("df.pt.slice_min() has been removed; use df.pt.pick(..., order='min') instead")

    def agg_df(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        raise AttributeError("df.pt.agg_df() has been removed; use df.pt.agg() instead")

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        if self.is_lazy:
            return self._df.select(pl.len()).collect().item()
        return len(self._df)

    def __iter__(self) -> Any:
        return iter(self.columns)

    def __getitem__(self, item: Any) -> Any:
        if self.is_lazy:
            if isinstance(item, str):
                return DataFrame(self._df.select(item))
            if isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
                return DataFrame(self._df.select(list(item)))
            return DataFrame(self._df.select(item))
        if isinstance(item, pl.Series) and item.dtype == pl.Boolean:
            return DataFrame(self._df.filter(item), orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)
        if isinstance(item, (list, tuple)) and item and isinstance(item[0], bool):
            return DataFrame(self._df.filter(pl.Series(item)), orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)
        col_key = (
            str(item) if not isinstance(item, (pl.Series, list, tuple)) and str(item) in self._df.columns else item
        )
        if isinstance(col_key, int) and col_key not in self._df.columns:
            raise KeyError(col_key)
        res = self._df[col_key]
        if isinstance(res, pl.DataFrame):
            return DataFrame(res, orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)
        return res

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return repr(self._df)

    def _repr_html_(self) -> str:
        if self.is_lazy:
            return f"<pre>{self.explain()}</pre>"
        return self._df._repr_html_()

    def head(self, n: int = 5) -> DataFrame:
        return DataFrame(self._df.head(n))

    def tail(self, n: int = 5) -> DataFrame:
        return DataFrame(self._df.tail(n))

    def sample(
        self,
        n: int | None = None,
        frac: float | None = None,
        *,
        fraction: float | None = None,
        seed: int | None = None,
        random_state: int | None = None,
        with_replacement: bool = False,
        replace: bool = False,
        shuffle: bool = False,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Randomly sample rows from the DataFrame.

        Parameters
        ----------
        n : int, optional
            Number of rows to sample. Defaults to 5 if neither n nor frac/fraction is provided.
        frac, fraction : float, optional
            Fraction of axis items to return (0.0 to 1.0).
        seed, random_state : int, optional
            Seed for reproducible random sampling.
        with_replacement, replace : bool, default False
            Allow sampling with replacement.
        shuffle : bool, default False
            Whether to shuffle the sampled rows.
        """
        effective_frac = frac if frac is not None else fraction
        effective_seed = seed if seed is not None else random_state
        effective_replace = with_replacement or replace

        eager_df = self._df.collect() if self.is_lazy else self._df
        if effective_frac is not None:
            sampled = eager_df.sample(
                fraction=effective_frac,
                with_replacement=effective_replace,
                shuffle=shuffle,
                seed=effective_seed,
            )
        else:
            n_val = 5 if n is None else n
            n_rows = len(eager_df)
            sample_n = min(n_val, n_rows) if not effective_replace else n_val
            sampled = (
                eager_df.sample(
                    n=sample_n,
                    with_replacement=effective_replace,
                    shuffle=shuffle,
                    seed=effective_seed,
                )
                if sample_n > 0
                else eager_df.head(0)
            )
        return DataFrame(sampled, orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)

    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Any:
        # Do not intercept private/dunder attributes or if _df is not yet initialized
        if name.startswith("_") or not hasattr(self, "_df"):
            raise AttributeError(f"'{type(self).__name__}' object has no attribute '{name}'")
        try:
            attr = getattr(self._df, name)
        except AttributeError:
            raise AttributeError(f"'{type(self).__name__}' object has no attribute '{name}'") from None

        if callable(attr):

            def _polars_method_wrapper(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
                clean_args = [
                    a._df
                    if isinstance(a, DataFrame)
                    else (a.to_polars() if hasattr(a, "to_polars") and not isinstance(a, (str, Path)) else a)
                    for a in args
                ]
                clean_kwargs = {
                    k: (
                        v._df
                        if isinstance(v, DataFrame)
                        else (v.to_polars() if hasattr(v, "to_polars") and not isinstance(v, (str, Path)) else v)
                    )
                    for k, v in kwargs.items()
                }
                res = attr(*clean_args, **clean_kwargs)
                if isinstance(res, (pl.DataFrame, pl.LazyFrame)):
                    return DataFrame(res)
                return res

            return _polars_method_wrapper
        return attr

    def join(
        self,
        other: Any,
        on: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        how: str = "inner",
        *,
        left_on: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        right_on: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        suffix: str = "_right",
        suffixes: tuple[str, str] | None = None,
        validate: str = "m:m",
        coalesce: bool | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Join this DataFrame with another tabular dataset using native Polars multithreading.

        Parameters
        ----------
        other : DataFrame | pl.DataFrame | pd.DataFrame | pl.LazyFrame | Any
            The other table to join with.
        on : str | Sequence[str] | None
            Join key column(s). Can be a single column string, comma-separated string,
            list of columns, or colon-delimited mapping (e.g. ``"id:user_id"``).
            If omitted and ``left_on``/``right_on`` are not specified, joins on common columns.
        how : str, default "inner"
            Type of join: ``"inner"``, ``"left"``, ``"right"``, ``"full"``,
            ``"semi"``, ``"anti"``, or ``"cross"``.
        left_on : str | Sequence[str] | None
            Key column(s) in the left table.
        right_on : str | Sequence[str] | None
            Key column(s) in the right table.
        suffix : str, default "_right"
            Suffix added to overlapping column names in the right frame.
        suffixes : tuple[str, str] | None, default None
            Suffixes added to overlapping column names: ``(left_suffix, right_suffix)``.
        validate : str, default "m:m"
            Validation check: ``"1:1"``, ``"1:m"``, ``"m:1"``, or ``"m:m"``.
        coalesce : bool | None, default None
            Whether to coalesce join keys. Defaults to True when keys match, or False
            when ``left_on != right_on`` to preserve both keys.

        Returns
        -------
        DataFrame
            Joined Pytae DataFrame. Retains lazy execution if both frames are lazy.
        """
        res = join_polars(
            self._df,
            other,
            on=on,
            how=how,
            left_on=left_on,
            right_on=right_on,
            suffix=suffix,
            suffixes=suffixes,
            validate=validate,
            coalesce=coalesce,
            **kwargs,
        )
        return DataFrame(res)

    def concat(
        self,
        *others: Any,
        how: str = "vertical",
        axis: int | str | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Concatenate this DataFrame with one or more other DataFrames vertically or horizontally.

        Parameters
        ----------
        *others : Any
            One or more DataFrames, Polars DataFrames, or Pandas DataFrames to stack.
        how : str, default "vertical"
            Concatenation strategy: ``"vertical"`` (stacks rows; falls back to ``"diagonal_relaxed"`` if
            schemas differ), ``"horizontal"``, ``"diagonal"``, or ``"diagonal_relaxed"``.
        axis : int | str | None, default None
            ``0`` or ``"vertical"`` for rows, ``1`` or ``"horizontal"`` for columns.

        Returns
        -------
        DataFrame
            Concatenated Pytae DataFrame.
        """
        all_dfs = [self._df, *others]
        res = concat_polars(all_dfs, how=how, axis=axis, **kwargs)
        return DataFrame(res)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Fluent Transformation Verbs
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def filter(self, *conditions: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> DataFrame:
        """Filter rows using conditions (string expressions, callables, or kwargs)."""
        if any(callable(c) for c in conditions):
            if kwargs or len(conditions) > 1:
                raise TypeError("callable/lambda predicates cannot be mixed with other filter arguments")
            cond = conditions[0]
            eager_self = self.collect() if self.is_lazy else self
            mask = cond(eager_self)
            if isinstance(mask, pl.Series):
                return DataFrame(eager_self._df.filter(mask))
            elif hasattr(mask, "values"):
                return DataFrame(eager_self._df.filter(pl.Series(mask.values)))
            else:
                return DataFrame(eager_self._df.filter(pl.Series(list(mask))))

        cond_pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
        for cond in conditions:
            if isinstance(cond, str):
                cond_pairs.extend(_parse_filter_string(cond))
            elif isinstance(cond, dict):
                cond_pairs.extend(cond.items())
            elif isinstance(cond, (list, tuple)) and cond and isinstance(cond[0], tuple):
                cond_pairs.extend(cond)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            elif isinstance(cond, tuple) and len(cond) == 2:
                cond_pairs.append(cond)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

        for k, v in kwargs.items():
            cond_pairs.append((k, v))

        return DataFrame(filter_polars(self._df, cond_pairs))

    def select(self, *names: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> DataFrame:
        """Select, reorder, slice, and drop columns using Pytae selection grammar."""
        return DataFrame(select_polars(self._df, list(names), kwargs), orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)

    def arrange(self, *specs: str, na_last: bool = True) -> DataFrame:
        """Sort rows by one or more column expressions (e.g. 'col1, -col2 desc')."""
        spec_str = ",".join(specs)
        return DataFrame(arrange_polars(self._df, spec_str, na_last=na_last))

    def distinct(self, *cols: Any, keep: str = "first") -> DataFrame:
        """Deduplicate rows across all or specific columns with keep='first'|'last'|'none'."""
        for c in cols:
            if isinstance(c, (list, tuple, set)):
                raise TypeError(
                    f"distinct() takes column names as positional arguments, e.g. distinct('a', 'b'). "
                    f"Lists are not accepted, got {type(c).__name__}."
                )
        if cols:
            avail = set(self.columns)
            missing = [str(c) for c in cols if str(c) not in avail]
            if missing:
                raise KeyError(f"distinct: column(s) {missing} not found in DataFrame")
        return DataFrame(distinct_polars(self._df, list(cols), keep=keep))

    def dropna(
        self, *cols: Any, subset: Any = None, how: str | None = None, drop_nans: bool = True
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Drop rows containing missing values (Arrow null and/or float NaN).

        Option B Zero Data Loss Philosophy:
        - Without arguments: drops completely empty rows (all columns null/NaN, how='all').
        - With column names: drops rows where any of the specified columns are null/NaN (how='any').
        - Pass how='any' or how='all' to explicitly override.
        - drop_nans=True (default) drops float NaNs in addition to Arrow nulls.
        """
        resolved = list(subset) if subset is not None else (list(cols) if cols else None)
        return DataFrame(dropna_polars(self._df, cols=resolved, how=how, drop_nans=drop_nans))

    def drop_nulls(
        self, *cols: Any, subset: Any = None, how: str | None = None, drop_nans: bool = True
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Alias for dropna()."""
        return self.dropna(*cols, subset=subset, how=how, drop_nans=drop_nans)

    def drop_na(
        self, *cols: Any, subset: Any = None, how: str | None = None, drop_nans: bool = True
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Alias for dropna()."""
        return self.dropna(*cols, subset=subset, how=how, drop_nans=drop_nans)

    def pick(
        self,
        spec: str,
        n: int | None = None,
        prop: float | None = None,
        order: str = "max",
        with_ties: bool = False,
        na_last: bool = True,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Select top/bottom rows by column expression (replaces slice_max/slice_min)."""
        return DataFrame(
            pick_polars(
                self._df,
                spec,
                by=None,
                n=n,
                prop=prop,
                order=order,
                with_ties=with_ties,
                na_last=na_last,
            )
        )

    def by(self, *cols: Any) -> GroupedDataFrame:
        """Establish a grouping context for subsequent .mutate(), .agg(), or .pick() operations."""
        if not cols:
            raise ValueError("df.pt.by() takes at least one column name")
        for c in cols:
            if c is None:
                raise TypeError("df.pt.by(None) is not supported")
            if isinstance(c, (list, tuple, set)):
                raise TypeError(
                    f"df.pt.by() takes column names as positional arguments, e.g. df.pt.by('a', 'b'). "
                    f"Lists are not accepted, got {type(c).__name__}."
                )
        resolved: list[str] = []
        for c in cols:
            if isinstance(c, str):
                if "," in c:
                    resolved.extend([_unquote_name(part.strip()) for part in c.split(",") if part.strip()])
                else:
                    resolved.append(_unquote_name(c.strip()))
            else:
                resolved.append(str(c))
        return GroupedDataFrame(self._df, resolved, orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map, orig_index=self._orig_index)

    def mutate(self, *specs: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> DataFrame:
        """Create or transform columns using vectorized expressions, math, if_else, map, shift."""
        if "by" in kwargs or "_by" in kwargs:
            raise TypeError(
                "df.pt.mutate() does not accept 'by'. Set grouping beforehand using pt.by(df, 'col') or df.pt.by('col')."
            )

        if not specs and not kwargs:
            raise ValueError(
                'mutate() expects at least one column specification (kwargs or string expressions), e.g. "col = expr"'
            )

        import inspect

        _here = inspect.currentframe()
        caller_frame = None if _here is None else _here.f_back
        del _here
        while caller_frame is not None:
            name = caller_frame.f_globals.get("__name__") or ""
            if name != "pytae" and not name.startswith("pytae."):
                break
            caller_frame = caller_frame.f_back
        frame_vars: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if caller_frame is not None:
            frame_vars.update(caller_frame.f_globals)
            frame_vars.update(caller_frame.f_locals)
        del caller_frame

        params = kwargs.pop("_params", None)
        if params is None and "params" in kwargs and isinstance(kwargs["params"], dict):
            params = kwargs.pop("params")

        merged_params = dict(frame_vars)
        if params:
            merged_params.update(params)

        callable_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
        other_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for k, v in kwargs.items():
            if callable(v):
                callable_kwargs[k] = v
            else:
                other_kwargs[k] = v

        parsed_spec: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for s in specs:
            if isinstance(s, str):
                entries = _parse_mutate_spec_entries(s)
                for k, v, _ in entries:
                    parsed_spec[k] = v
            elif isinstance(s, dict):
                for k, v in s.items():
                    parsed_spec[str(k)] = v
            elif callable(s):
                raise TypeError(
                    "mutate() expects callables as keyword arguments with the column name, "
                    "e.g. df.pt.mutate(new_col=lambda d: d['x'] * 2)"
                )
            else:
                raise TypeError(f"mutate() received unexpected positional argument of type {type(s).__name__}.")

        for k, v in other_kwargs.items():
            parsed_spec[k] = v

        res_df = mutate_polars(self._df, parsed_spec, by=None, params=merged_params) if parsed_spec else self._df
        res = DataFrame(res_df, orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)
        res._orig_index = self._orig_index

        for col_name, fn in callable_kwargs.items():
            col_res = fn(res)
            if hasattr(col_res, "to_numpy"):
                res = DataFrame(
                    res._df.with_columns(pl.Series(col_name, col_res.to_numpy())), orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map
                )
            else:
                res = DataFrame(
                    res._df.with_columns(pl.Series(col_name, list(col_res))), orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map
                )
            res._orig_index = self._orig_index

        return res

    def rename(self, *args: Any, columns: dict[str, str] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> DataFrame:
        """Rename columns using mapping dictionary or columns keyword argument."""
        mapping: dict[str, str] = {}
        if args and isinstance(args[0], dict):
            mapping.update(args[0])
        if columns:
            mapping.update(columns)
        if kwargs:
            mapping.update(kwargs)
        new_df = self._df.rename(mapping)
        new_col_map = dict(self._orig_col_map)
        for old, new in mapping.items():
            new_col_map[new] = new
        res = DataFrame(new_df, orig_col_map=new_col_map)
        res._orig_index = self._orig_index
        return res

    def agg(self, *specs: Any, a: Any = None, dropna: bool = False, **kwargs: Any) -> DataFrame:
        """Aggregate numeric columns or compute custom metrics across the whole DataFrame."""
        if "by" in kwargs or "_by" in kwargs:
            raise TypeError(
                "df.pt.agg() does not accept 'by'. Set grouping beforehand using pt.by(df, 'col') or df.pt.by('col')."
            )
        return DataFrame(agg_polars(self._df, *specs, by=None, a=a, dropna=dropna, **kwargs))

    def pivot(
        self,
        r: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        c: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        v: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        a: str = "sum",
        dropna: bool = False,
        f_v: Any = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Compute multi-dimensional cross-tabulations and pivot tables."""
        c_list = [c] if isinstance(c, str) else (list(c) if c else [])
        for col in c_list:
            if str(col) in self._col_collisions:
                raise ValueError("Pivoting would result in column headers that contain duplicate names")
        return DataFrame(
            pivot_polars(self._df, r=r, c=c, v=v, a=a, dropna=dropna, f_v=f_v, _func_name="pivot", **kwargs)
        )

    def long(
        self,
        cols: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        id_vars: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        c: str = "variable",
        v: str = "value",
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Reshape DataFrame from wide to long format (unpivot/melt)."""
        return DataFrame(long_polars(self._df, cols=cols, id_vars=id_vars, c=c, v=v))

    def wide(
        self,
        r: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        c: str = "variable",
        v: str = "value",
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Reshape DataFrame from long to wide format (1-to-1 un-melt)."""
        return DataFrame(wide_polars(self._df, r=r, c=c, v=v, **kwargs))

    def clean_columns(
        self,
        *,
        strip: bool = False,
        strip_special: bool = False,
        squeeze: bool = False,
        fill: str | None = None,
        case: str | None = None,
        dedupe: bool = False,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Clean and normalize column header names."""
        return DataFrame(
            clean_columns_polars(
                self._df,
                strip=strip,
                strip_special=strip_special,
                squeeze=squeeze,
                fill=fill,
                case=case,
                dedupe=dedupe,
            )
        )

    def replace_values(
        self,
        v: dict[Any, Any],
        c: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
        exact: bool = True,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Replace exact values or substrings across columns."""
        return DataFrame(
            replace_values_polars(
                self._df,
                v=v,
                c=c,
                exact=exact,
            )
        )

    def handle_missing(
        self,
        fillna: str | None = ".",
        numeric_fill: Any = 0,
        cols: Sequence[str] | None = None,
        preserve_categories: bool = True,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Fill null values with type-appropriate defaults."""
        return DataFrame(
            handle_missing_polars(
                self._df,
                fillna=fillna,
                numeric_fill=numeric_fill,
                cols=cols,
                preserve_categories=preserve_categories,
                **kwargs,
            )
        )

    def cols(self, ascending: bool | None = True) -> list[str]:
        """Return sorted or natural column names."""
        columns = list(self.columns)
        if ascending is True:
            return sorted(columns)
        elif ascending is False:
            return sorted(columns, reverse=True)
        elif ascending is None:
            return columns
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid ascending value '{ascending}'. Must be True, False, or None")

    def glimpse(self, width: int | None = None) -> DataFrame:
        """Print an R tibble / tidyverse-style schema and preview of the DataFrame."""
        from pytae.other_utilities import format_glimpse

        print(format_glimpse(self, width=width))
        return self

    def freq(self, col: str | None = None, dropna: bool = False) -> DataFrame:
        """Calculate frequency distribution of unique column values."""
        from pytae.other_utilities import freq as _freq

        return DataFrame(_freq(self.to_pandas(), col=col, dropna=dropna))

    def hist(self, col: str | None = None, bins: int = 10) -> DataFrame:
        """Compute a binned distribution histogram with ASCII bars and percentages for a numeric column."""
        from pytae.other_utilities import hist as _hist

        return DataFrame(_hist(self.to_pandas(), col=col, bins=bins))

    def pipe(self, func: Callable[..., Any], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        """Apply a callable function taking DataFrame as its first argument."""
        return func(self, *args, **kwargs)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Interop & Export
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def to_pandas(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        """Convert to pandas DataFrame, preserving tracked index and column metadata."""
        import pandas as pd

        eager_df = self._df.collect() if self.is_lazy else self._df
        pdf = eager_df.to_pandas(*args, **kwargs)
        if self._orig_index is not None and len(self._orig_index) == len(pdf):
            pdf.index = pd.Index(self._orig_index)
        if self._orig_col_map:
            pdf.columns = [self._orig_col_map.get(c, c) for c in pdf.columns]
        return pdf

    def to_polars(self) -> pl.DataFrame:
        """Extract the underlying Polars DataFrame (collecting if lazy)."""
        if self.is_lazy:
            return self._df.collect()
        return self._df

    def to_clip(self) -> None:
        """Copy DataFrame to system clipboard via TSV without index."""
        eager_df = self._df.collect() if self.is_lazy else self._df
        tsv_str = eager_df.write_csv(separator="\t")
        system = platform.system()
        try:
            if system == "Darwin":
                p = subprocess.Popen(["pbcopy"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(tsv_str.encode("utf-8"))
            elif system == "Windows":
                p = subprocess.Popen(["clip"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(tsv_str.encode("utf-8"))
            else:
                p = subprocess.Popen(["xclip", "-selection", "clipboard"], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(tsv_str.encode("utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            self.to_pandas().to_clipboard(index=False)

    def to_parquet(self, path: str | Path, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        kwargs.pop("index", None)
        if self.is_lazy:
            try:
                self._df.sink_parquet(path, **kwargs)
                return
            except Exception:
                self._df.collect().write_parquet(path, **kwargs)
                return
        self._df.write_parquet(path, **kwargs)

    def to_csv(self, path: str | Path, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        kwargs.pop("index", None)
        if self.is_lazy:
            try:
                self._df.sink_csv(path, **kwargs)
                return
            except Exception:
                self._df.collect().write_csv(path, **kwargs)
                return
        self._df.write_csv(path, **kwargs)

    def plot(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        """Create visualizations using Pytae Plotter."""
        return _plot_impl(self.to_pandas(), *args, **kwargs)


class GroupedDataFrame:
    """A lazy grouped container backed by a Polars DataFrame or LazyFrame and grouping key columns."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        df: Any,
        by_cols: list[str],
        orig_col_map: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        orig_index: Any = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._df = df
        self._by = by_cols
        self._orig_col_map = orig_col_map or {}
        self._orig_index = orig_index

    @property
    def pt(self) -> GroupedDataFrame:
        """Allow fluid chaining whether or not .pt is repeated."""
        return self

    @property
    def attrs(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"_pt_by": tuple(self._by)}

    def by(self, *cols: Any) -> GroupedDataFrame:
        """Overwrite grouping with new keys."""
        return DataFrame(self._df, orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map).by(*cols)

    def ungroup(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Remove grouping context and return a standard DataFrame."""
        res = DataFrame(self._df, orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)
        res._orig_index = self._orig_index
        return res

    def to_pandas(self) -> Any:
        import pandas as pd

        pdf = self._df.to_pandas()
        if self._orig_index is not None and len(self._orig_index) == len(pdf):
            pdf.index = pd.Index(self._orig_index)
        return pdf

    def mutate(self, *specs: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> DataFrame:
        """Calculate windowed mutations across the established groups."""
        if "by" in kwargs or "_by" in kwargs:
            raise TypeError(
                "df.pt.mutate() does not accept 'by'. Set grouping beforehand using pt.by(df, 'col') or df.pt.by('col')."
            )

        if not specs and not kwargs:
            raise ValueError(
                'mutate() expects at least one column specification (kwargs or string expressions), e.g. "col = expr"'
            )

        dropna = kwargs.pop("dropna", False)

        import inspect

        _here = inspect.currentframe()
        caller_frame = None if _here is None else _here.f_back
        del _here
        while caller_frame is not None:
            name = caller_frame.f_globals.get("__name__") or ""
            if name != "pytae" and not name.startswith("pytae."):
                break
            caller_frame = caller_frame.f_back
        frame_vars: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if caller_frame is not None:
            frame_vars.update(caller_frame.f_globals)
            frame_vars.update(caller_frame.f_locals)
        del caller_frame

        params = kwargs.pop("_params", None)
        if params is None and "params" in kwargs and isinstance(kwargs["params"], dict):
            params = kwargs.pop("params")

        merged_params = dict(frame_vars)
        if params:
            merged_params.update(params)

        callable_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
        other_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for k, v in kwargs.items():
            if callable(v):
                callable_kwargs[k] = v
            else:
                other_kwargs[k] = v

        parsed_spec: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for s in specs:
            if isinstance(s, str):
                entries = _parse_mutate_spec_entries(s)
                for k, v, _ in entries:
                    parsed_spec[k] = v
            elif isinstance(s, dict):
                for k, v in s.items():
                    parsed_spec[str(k)] = v
            elif callable(s):
                raise TypeError(
                    "mutate() expects callables as keyword arguments with the column name, "
                    "e.g. df.pt.mutate(new_col=lambda d: d['x'] * 2)"
                )
            else:
                raise TypeError(f"mutate() received unexpected positional argument of type {type(s).__name__}.")

        for k, v in other_kwargs.items():
            parsed_spec[k] = v

        res_df = (
            mutate_polars(self._df, parsed_spec, by=self._by, params=merged_params, dropna=dropna)
            if parsed_spec
            else self._df
        )
        res = DataFrame(res_df, orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)
        res._orig_index = self._orig_index

        if callable_kwargs:
            pdf = res.to_pandas()
            for col_name, fn in callable_kwargs.items():
                pieces = []
                for _, group in pdf.groupby(self._by, sort=False, dropna=dropna):
                    import pandas as pd

                    part_res = fn(group)
                    if isinstance(part_res, pd.Series):
                        pieces.append(part_res)
                    elif hasattr(part_res, "__iter__") and not isinstance(part_res, (str, bytes)):
                        pieces.append(pd.Series(list(part_res), index=group.index))
                    else:
                        pieces.append(pd.Series([part_res] * len(group), index=group.index))
                import pandas as pd

                full_col = pd.concat(pieces).reindex(pdf.index)
                res = DataFrame(
                    res._df.with_columns(pl.Series(col_name, full_col.to_numpy())), orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map
                )
                res._orig_index = self._orig_index

        return res

    def agg(self, *specs: Any, a: Any = None, dropna: bool = False, **kwargs: Any) -> DataFrame:
        """Aggregate numeric columns or compute metrics grouped by the established keys."""
        if "by" in kwargs or "_by" in kwargs:
            raise TypeError(
                "df.pt.agg() does not accept 'by'. Set grouping beforehand using pt.by(df, 'col') or df.pt.by('col')."
            )
        return DataFrame(agg_polars(self._df, *specs, by=self._by, a=a, dropna=dropna, **kwargs))

    def dropna(
        self, *cols: Any, subset: Any = None, how: str | None = None, drop_nans: bool = True
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Drop rows containing missing values (Arrow null and/or float NaN)."""
        resolved = list(subset) if subset is not None else (list(cols) if cols else None)
        return DataFrame(dropna_polars(self._df, cols=resolved, how=how, drop_nans=drop_nans))

    def drop_nulls(
        self, *cols: Any, subset: Any = None, how: str | None = None, drop_nans: bool = True
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Alias for dropna()."""
        return self.dropna(*cols, subset=subset, how=how, drop_nans=drop_nans)

    def drop_na(
        self, *cols: Any, subset: Any = None, how: str | None = None, drop_nans: bool = True
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Alias for dropna()."""
        return self.dropna(*cols, subset=subset, how=how, drop_nans=drop_nans)

    def pick(
        self,
        spec: str,
        n: int | None = None,
        prop: float | None = None,
        order: str = "max",
        with_ties: bool = False,
        na_last: bool = True,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Select top/bottom rows per group."""
        return DataFrame(
            pick_polars(
                self._df,
                spec,
                by=self._by,
                n=n,
                prop=prop,
                order=order,
                with_ties=with_ties,
                na_last=na_last,
            )
        )

    def sample(
        self,
        n: int | None = None,
        frac: float | None = None,
        *,
        fraction: float | None = None,
        seed: int | None = None,
        random_state: int | None = None,
        with_replacement: bool = False,
        replace: bool = False,
        shuffle: bool = False,
    ) -> DataFrame:
        """Sample rows from each group established by pt.by()."""
        effective_frac = frac if frac is not None else fraction
        effective_seed = seed if seed is not None else random_state
        effective_replace = with_replacement or replace
        n_val = 5 if n is None and effective_frac is None else n

        eager_df = self._df.collect() if isinstance(self._df, pl.LazyFrame) else self._df
        parts = []
        for _, sub_df in eager_df.group_by(self._by):
            if effective_frac is not None:
                parts.append(
                    sub_df.sample(
                        fraction=effective_frac,
                        with_replacement=effective_replace,
                        shuffle=shuffle,
                        seed=effective_seed,
                    )
                )
            else:
                sample_n = min(n_val, len(sub_df)) if not effective_replace else n_val
                parts.append(
                    sub_df.sample(
                        n=sample_n,
                        with_replacement=effective_replace,
                        shuffle=shuffle,
                        seed=effective_seed,
                    )
                    if sample_n > 0
                    else sub_df.head(0)
                )
        res = pl.concat(parts) if parts else eager_df.head(0)
        return DataFrame(res, orig_col_map=self._orig_col_map)

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<GroupedDataFrame by={self._by}>\n{self._df}"

    def _repr_html_(self) -> str:
        return f"<p><strong>Grouped by:</strong> {', '.join(self._by)}</p>{self._df._repr_html_()}"


def _plot_impl(pdf: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    """Shared Plotter bridge implementation handling faceting and kwargs splitting."""
    try:
        from pytae.plotting import Plotter
    except ImportError as exc:
        raise ImportError("plot() requires matplotlib. Install with: pip install 'pytae[plot]'") from exc

    import pandas as pd

    if not isinstance(pdf, pd.DataFrame):
        if hasattr(pdf, "to_pandas"):
            pdf = pdf.to_pandas()
        else:
            pdf = pd.DataFrame(pdf)

    by_col = kwargs.get("by") if kwargs.get("by") is not None else kwargs.get("col")
    has_facet_trigger = kwargs.get("ncols") is not None or kwargs.get("facet") is True or "col" in kwargs
    is_plot_call = bool({"kind", "x", "y", "column"}.intersection(kwargs.keys()))

    if by_col is not None and by_col in pdf.columns and has_facet_trigger and is_plot_call:
        if "mosaic" in kwargs or (len(args) > 0 and args[0] is not None):
            raise ValueError("Cannot combine 'mosaic' with faceting ('by' with 'ncols'/'facet'/'col').")
        if "nrows" in kwargs:
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot combine 'nrows' with faceting ('by' with 'ncols'/'facet'/'col'). Use 'ncols' to control grid columns."
            )

        facet_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
        facet_kwargs.pop("by", None)
        facet_kwargs.pop("col", None)
        facet_kwargs.pop("facet", None)
        ncols = facet_kwargs.pop("ncols", None)
        return Plotter.facet(pdf, by=by_col, ncols=ncols, **facet_kwargs)

    save_path = kwargs.pop("save", None)
    plotter_keys = {"mosaic", "figsize", "aggregate", "sharex", "sharey", "nrows", "ncols"}
    init_kwargs = {k: v for k, v in kwargs.items() if k in plotter_keys}
    plot_kwargs = {k: v for k, v in kwargs.items() if k not in plotter_keys}

    plotter = Plotter(*args, **init_kwargs)
    plotter.data(pdf)
    if plot_kwargs:
        plotter.plot(**plot_kwargs)
    if save_path:
        plotter.finalize().save(save_path)
    return plotter

"""General tabular utilities: clipboard export, missing-value handling, column sorting, header cleaning, and value replacement."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections.abc import Hashable, Sequence
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd

from pytae._text import unquote_name as _unquote_name


def to_clip(df: pd.DataFrame | pd.Series) -> None:
    """Copy the DataFrame or Series to the system clipboard (tab-separated, no index)."""
    return df.to_clipboard(index=False)


pd.DataFrame.to_clip = to_clip
pd.Series.to_clip = to_clip


def safe_reset_index(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Reset index, ensuring no index level name collides with existing columns."""
    if isinstance(df.index, pd.RangeIndex) and df.index.name is None:
        return df
    idx_names = list(df.index.names)
    col_names = [str(col) for col in df.columns]
    colliding = []
    used_names = set(col_names)
    for i, name in enumerate(idx_names):
        target_name = str(name) if name is not None else ("index" if len(idx_names) == 1 else f"level_{i}")
        if target_name in used_names:
            colliding.append(target_name)
    if colliding:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Resetting index failed: index level name(s) {colliding} collide with existing column name(s). "
            "Rename the column or index before resetting."
        )
    return df.reset_index()


def handle_missing(
    df: Any,
    fillna: str | None = ".",
    numeric_fill: Any = 0,
    cols: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    preserve_categories: bool = True,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> Any:
    """Fill missing values across columns with type-appropriate defaults."""
    from pytae.dataframe import DataFrame

    return DataFrame(df).handle_missing(
        fillna=fillna,
        numeric_fill=numeric_fill,
        cols=cols,
        preserve_categories=preserve_categories,
        **kwargs,
    )


def cols(df: Any, ascending: bool | None = True) -> list[str]:
    """Return the column names of the DataFrame sorted or in original order."""
    from pytae.dataframe import DataFrame

    return DataFrame(df).cols(ascending=ascending)


def clean_column_names(
    names: Sequence[Hashable],
    *,
    strip: bool = False,
    strip_special: bool = False,
    squeeze: bool = False,
    fill: str | None = None,
    case: str | None = None,
    dedupe: bool = False,
) -> list:
    """Clean a list of header names, in a fixed order: strip -> strip_special
    -> squeeze -> fill -> case -> dedupe.

    strip: trim leading/trailing whitespace.
    strip_special: remove anything that isn't a letter, digit, underscore,
        whitespace, or the fill character (e.g. %, $, #, !, parentheses,
        quotes) — if fill is set, that character is kept in place rather
        than stripped, since it's the intended separator.
    squeeze: collapse runs of internal whitespace to a single space.
    fill: replace each individual whitespace character with this string (pair
        with squeeze=True to collapse multi-space runs to one separator first).
    case: 'lower', 'upper', or 'proper' (str.title()).
    dedupe: number collisions after cleaning (revenue, revenue_1, revenue_2, ...).
    """
    cleaned = list(names)
    if strip:
        cleaned = [str(name).strip() for name in cleaned]
    if strip_special:
        keep = "".join(re.escape(ch) for ch in fill) if fill else ""
        pattern = re.compile(rf"[^\w\s{keep}]")
        cleaned = [pattern.sub("", str(name)) for name in cleaned]
    if squeeze:
        cleaned = [re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(name)) for name in cleaned]
    if fill is not None:
        cleaned = [re.sub(r"\s", fill, str(name)) for name in cleaned]
    if case == "lower":
        cleaned = [str(name).lower() for name in cleaned]
    elif case == "upper":
        cleaned = [str(name).upper() for name in cleaned]
    elif case == "proper":
        cleaned = [str(name).title() for name in cleaned]
    if dedupe:
        seen = {}
        used = set(cleaned)  # original names, so a generated suffix never collides with a real one
        deduped = []
        for name in cleaned:
            if name not in seen:
                seen[name] = 0
                deduped.append(name)
            else:
                seen[name] += 1
                candidate = f"{name}_{seen[name]}"
                while candidate in used:
                    seen[name] += 1
                    candidate = f"{name}_{seen[name]}"
                used.add(candidate)
                deduped.append(candidate)
        cleaned = deduped
    return cleaned


def clean_columns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    strip: bool = False,
    strip_special: bool = False,
    squeeze: bool = False,
    fill: str | None = None,
    case: str | None = None,
    dedupe: bool = False,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Clean column header names (see clean_column_names() for the per-key behavior)."""
    df = df.copy()
    df.columns = clean_column_names(
        list(df.columns),
        strip=strip,
        strip_special=strip_special,
        squeeze=squeeze,
        fill=fill,
        case=case,
        dedupe=dedupe,
    )
    return df


def replace_values(
    df: Any,
    v: dict[Any, Any],
    c: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
    exact: bool = True,
) -> Any:
    """Replace values optionally scoped to specific columns."""
    from pytae.dataframe import DataFrame

    return DataFrame(df).replace_values(v=v, c=c, exact=exact)


def format_glimpse(df: Any, width: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Format DataFrame as a transposed glimpse summary (like dplyr::glimpse / Polars).

    Parameters:
    -----------
    df : Any
        DataFrame, Polars DataFrame, or Polars LazyFrame to glimpse.
    width : int, optional
        Maximum line width (defaults to terminal width or 80).
    """
    import shutil

    if width is None:
        width = shutil.get_terminal_size(fallback=(80, 24)).columns

    try:
        import polars as pl

        from pytae.dataframe import DataFrame

        underlying = df._df if isinstance(df, DataFrame) else df
        if isinstance(underlying, (pl.DataFrame, pl.LazyFrame)):
            if isinstance(underlying, pl.LazyFrame):
                try:
                    n_rows = underlying.select(pl.len()).collect().item()
                except Exception:
                    n_rows = len(underlying.collect())
                schema = underlying.collect_schema()
                preview = underlying.limit(25).collect()
            else:
                n_rows = underlying.height
                schema = underlying.schema
                preview = underlying.head(25)

            col_names = [str(c) for c in schema.names()]
            lines = [
                f"Rows: {n_rows:,}",
                f"Columns: {len(col_names):,}",
            ]
            if not col_names:
                return "\n".join(lines)

            max_col_len = min(max((len(c) for c in col_names), default=0), 30)
            dtypes = [f"<{schema[c]}>" for c in col_names]
            max_dtype_len = min(max((len(d) for d in dtypes), default=0), 20)

            for col, dtype_str in zip(col_names, dtypes):
                prefix = f"$ {col.ljust(max_col_len)} {dtype_str.ljust(max_dtype_len)} "
                sample_vals: list[str] = []
                for val in preview[col].to_list():
                    if val is None:
                        sample_vals.append("NA")
                    elif isinstance(val, str):
                        sample_vals.append(repr(val))
                    else:
                        sample_vals.append(str(val))

                remaining_width = max(width - len(prefix), 10)
                vals_str = ", ".join(sample_vals)
                if len(vals_str) > remaining_width:
                    vals_str = vals_str[: remaining_width - 3].rstrip(", ") + "..."
                lines.append(prefix + vals_str)

            return "\n".join(lines)
    except Exception:
        pass

    lines = [
        f"Rows: {len(df):,}",
        f"Columns: {len(df.columns):,}",
    ]
    if len(df.columns) == 0:
        return "\n".join(lines)

    col_names = [str(c) for c in df.columns]
    max_col_len = min(max((len(c) for c in col_names), default=0), 30)

    dtypes = [f"<{df[col].dtype}>" for col in df.columns]
    max_dtype_len = min(max((len(d) for d in dtypes), default=0), 20)

    for col, dtype_str in zip(df.columns, dtypes):
        col_str = str(col)
        prefix = f"$ {col_str.ljust(max_col_len)} {dtype_str.ljust(max_dtype_len)} "
        sample_vals = []
        for val in df[col].head(25):
            if pd.isna(val):
                sample_vals.append("NA")
            elif isinstance(val, str):
                sample_vals.append(repr(val))
            else:
                sample_vals.append(str(val))

        remaining_width = max(width - len(prefix), 10)
        vals_str = ", ".join(sample_vals)
        if len(vals_str) > remaining_width:
            vals_str = vals_str[: remaining_width - 3].rstrip(", ") + "..."
        lines.append(prefix + vals_str)

    return "\n".join(lines)


def glimpse(df: Any, width: int | None = None) -> Any:
    """Print a transposed overview of DataFrame columns, dtypes, and sample values.

    Returns the original DataFrame for method chaining.
    """
    print(format_glimpse(df, width=width))
    return df


def distinct(
    df: Any,
    *cols: Any,
    keep: str = "first",
) -> Any:
    """Drop duplicate rows, optionally restricted to specific key columns."""
    from pytae.dataframe import DataFrame

    return DataFrame(df).distinct(*cols, keep=keep)


def freq(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    col: str | None = None,
    *,
    dropna: bool = False,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute a frequency table with ASCII distribution bars and percentages for a column.

    Parameters:
    -----------
    df : pd.DataFrame
        Input DataFrame.
    col : str, optional
        Column name to inspect. Required unless `df` has only a single column.
    dropna : bool, default False
        Whether to exclude NA/null values from the frequency counts.

    Returns:
    --------
    pd.DataFrame
        DataFrame with columns `[col, 'Count', 'Distribution']`.
    """
    if col is None or (isinstance(col, str) and not col.strip()):
        if len(df.columns) == 1:
            target_col = str(df.columns[0])
        else:
            raise ValueError("freq() requires a column name (or a single-column DataFrame)")
    else:
        target_col = _unquote_name(str(col).strip())

    if target_col not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"freq: column '{target_col}' not found in DataFrame. Available columns: {list(df.columns)}")

    counts = df[target_col].value_counts(dropna=dropna)
    total = counts.sum()
    max_cnt = counts.max() if not counts.empty else 1
    bar_max_width = 20
    data = []
    for category, count in counts.items():
        bar_len = int(round((count / max_cnt) * bar_max_width)) if max_cnt > 0 else 0
        bar_str = "█" * bar_len
        pct_str = f"({(count / total * 100):.1f}%)" if total > 0 else "(0.0%)"
        dist_str = f"{bar_str} {pct_str}".strip()
        data.append({target_col: str(category), "Count": count, "Distribution": dist_str})
    return pd.DataFrame(data, columns=[target_col, "Count", "Distribution"])


def hist(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    col: str | None = None,
    bins: int = 10,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute a binned distribution histogram with ASCII bars and percentages for a numeric column.

    Parameters:
    -----------
    df : pd.DataFrame
        Input DataFrame.
    col : str, optional
        Column name or `'col:bins'` specification (e.g. `'body_mass_g'` or `'body_mass_g:10'`).
        Required unless `df` has only a single column.
    bins : int, default 10
        Number of equal-width bins (overridden if `:bins` or `,bins=` is specified in `col`).

    Returns:
    --------
    pd.DataFrame
        DataFrame with columns `['Range', 'Count', 'Distribution']`.
    """
    raw = col.strip() if isinstance(col, str) else ""
    target_col: str | None = None

    if ":" in raw:
        col_part, _, b_str = raw.rpartition(":")
        if col_part.strip() and b_str.strip() and col_part.strip() not in df.columns:
            target_col = _unquote_name(col_part.strip())
            try:
                bins = int(b_str.strip())
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"hist: invalid bins value '{b_str.strip()}'; must be a positive integer") from exc
        elif col_part.strip() in df.columns and b_str.strip().isdigit():
            target_col = col_part.strip()
            bins = int(b_str.strip())
        else:
            target_col = _unquote_name(raw)
    elif "," in raw and "bins=" in raw:
        col_part, _, b_part = raw.partition(",")
        target_col = _unquote_name(col_part.strip())
        b_str = b_part.replace("bins=", "").strip()
        try:
            bins = int(b_str)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"hist: invalid bins value '{b_str}'; must be a positive integer") from exc
    elif raw:
        target_col = _unquote_name(raw)
    elif col is not None and not isinstance(col, str):
        target_col = str(col)
    else:
        if len(df.columns) == 1:
            target_col = str(df.columns[0])
        else:
            raise ValueError("hist() requires a column name (e.g. 'mass' or 'mass:10')")

    if not isinstance(bins, int) or isinstance(bins, bool) or bins <= 0:
        raise ValueError(f"hist: bins must be a positive integer, got {bins!r}")

    if target_col not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"hist: column '{target_col}' not found in DataFrame. Available columns: {list(df.columns)}")

    s = pd.to_numeric(df[target_col], errors="coerce").dropna()
    if s.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=["Range", "Count", "Distribution"])

    cut_series = pd.cut(s, bins=bins, include_lowest=True)
    counts = cut_series.value_counts(sort=False)
    total = len(s)
    max_cnt = counts.max() if not counts.empty else 1
    bar_max_width = 20
    data = []
    for interval, count in counts.items():
        bar_len = int(round((count / max_cnt) * bar_max_width)) if max_cnt > 0 else 0
        bar_str = "█" * bar_len
        pct_str = f"({(count / total * 100):.1f}%)" if total > 0 else "(0.0%)"
        dist_str = f"{bar_str} {pct_str}".strip()
        left_fmt = f"{interval.left:.2f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
        right_fmt = f"{interval.right:.2f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
        range_str = f"[{left_fmt}, {right_fmt}]"
        data.append({"Range": range_str, "Count": count, "Distribution": dist_str})
    return pd.DataFrame(data, columns=["Range", "Count", "Distribution"])

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import math
import warnings
from typing import Any

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _check_no_aggregation(kwargs: dict) -> None:
    if "aggfunc" in kwargs or "aggregate" in kwargs:
        raise ValueError(
            "Plotter does not perform aggregation. "
            "Aggregate your DataFrame first using df.pt.agg(...) or df.pt.pivot(...) before plotting."
        )


# pytae's own control kwargs -- these drive Plotter's behavior directly and are
# never forwarded to pandas.plot() (see _prepare_plot_kwargs/_filter_plot_kwargs).
_CONTROL_KWARGS = [
    "on",
    "print_data",
    "clip_data",
    "secondary_y",
    "xlabel",
    "ylabel",
    "palette",
    "annot",
    "fmt",
]

# Per-kind config: `strip` = last_kwargs keys to remove before calling pandas'
# own .plot(kind=...) (pytae-only knobs that aren't real pandas.plot() kwargs for
# that kind); `unsupported` = {kwarg: warning message} for kwargs that don't
# apply to this kind at all (warned about, then dropped via `strip`).
_KIND_SPECS = {
    "scatter": {
        "strip": ["dropna", *_CONTROL_KWARGS],
        "unsupported": {
            "dropna": "The 'dropna' argument is not applicable to scatter plots and will be ignored.",
        },
    },
    "hexbin": {
        "strip": ["by", "dropna", *_CONTROL_KWARGS],
        "unsupported": {
            "dropna": "The 'dropna' argument is not applicable to hex plots and will be ignored.",
            "by": "Use 'c' and 'cmap' to split the hex plot by a particular column. The 'by' argument will be ignored.",
        },
    },
    "pie": {
        "strip": ["x", "by", "dropna", *_CONTROL_KWARGS],
        "unsupported": {},
    },
    "line": {
        "strip": ["y", "by", "dropna", *_CONTROL_KWARGS],
        "unsupported": {},
    },
    "box": {
        "strip": ["x", "y", "by", "dropna", "column", *_CONTROL_KWARGS],
        "unsupported": {
            "dropna": "The 'dropna' argument is not applicable to box plots and will be ignored.",
        },
    },
    "heatmap": {
        "strip": ["x", "y", "by", "dropna", "column", *_CONTROL_KWARGS],
        "unsupported": {},
    },
    "other": {
        "strip": ["y", "by", "dropna", *_CONTROL_KWARGS],
        "unsupported": {},
    },
    "kde": {
        "strip": ["x", "y", "by", "dropna", "column", *_CONTROL_KWARGS],
        "unsupported": {},
    },
    "hist": {
        "strip": ["x", "y", "by", "dropna", "column", *_CONTROL_KWARGS],
        "unsupported": {},
    },
}
_KIND_SPECS["density"] = _KIND_SPECS["kde"]  # 'kde' and 'density' are aliases

# Kwargs each kind needs set (via .data()/.plot(x=, y=, by=, column=, ...)) before
# it can render at all -- checked up front so a missing one raises a clear pytae
# error instead of a cryptic pandas KeyError deep inside pandas.
_REQUIRED_KWARGS = {
    "scatter": ["x", "y"],
    "hexbin": ["x", "y"],
    "line": ["x"],
    "other": ["x"],
    "box": ["y"],
    "pie": ["by", "y"],
    "kde": ["column"],
    "density": ["column"],
    "hist": ["column"],
    "heatmap": [],
}


def _normalize_col_label(c: object) -> str:
    if c is None or (isinstance(c, float) and np.isnan(c)) or pd.isna(c):
        return "nan"
    if isinstance(c, (float, np.floating)) and float(c).is_integer():
        return str(int(c))
    return str(c)


def _holds_integer(cols: pd.Index) -> bool:
    return getattr(cols, "dtype", None) is not None and getattr(cols.dtype, "kind", None) in "iu"


def _remap_coord_if_needed(cols: pd.Index, val: Any) -> Any:
    if not isinstance(val, bool) and isinstance(val, (int, np.integer)) and val in cols:
        if _holds_integer(cols):
            return val
        if hasattr(cols, "_holds_integer") and cols._holds_integer():
            return val
        loc = cols.get_loc(val)
        if isinstance(loc, slice):
            return loc.start
        if isinstance(loc, np.ndarray):
            return int(np.where(loc)[0][0])
        return loc
    return val


def _reshape_by_to_wide(
    df: pd.DataFrame, x: Any, by: Any, y: Any, kind_name: str, dropna: bool = False
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Reshape tidy (x, by, y) into wide columns per 'by' category without aggregation."""
    sub = df[[x, by, y]].copy()
    if dropna:
        sub = sub.dropna(subset=[x, by])
    if sub[[x, by]].duplicated().any():
        raise ValueError(
            f"Plotter: cannot plot {kind_name} with by='{by}' because duplicate ({x}, {by}) pairs exist. "
            "Aggregate first using df.pt.pivot(...) or df.pt.agg(...) before plotting."
        )
    raw_piv = sub.pivot(index=x, columns=by, values=y)
    norm_x = _normalize_col_label(x)
    for col in raw_piv.columns:
        if _normalize_col_label(col) == norm_x:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Plotter: category '{col}' in 'by={by}' collides with x-axis column name '{x}'. "
                "Rename the category or x-axis column to avoid ambiguous plot data."
            )
    res = raw_piv.reset_index()
    res.columns.name = None
    return res


class Plotter:
    """
    Method chainable .data() .. .plot() .. .plot() .. .data() .. .plot() .. .finalize()..
    All args from previous plot call are carried forward unless data is changed or plot kind is changed.

    All pandas.plot **kwargs are supported except secondary_y. This is because we are handling secondary axis ourselves (e.g. A^).
    All artists like color, style etc are supported explicitly via dict or built-in palette.
    """

    _last_active = None

    def __new__(cls, *args, **kwargs):
        df = args[0] if args else kwargs.get("df")
        by_col = kwargs.get("by") if kwargs.get("by") is not None else kwargs.get("col")
        has_facet_trigger = kwargs.get("ncols") is not None or kwargs.get("facet") is True or "col" in kwargs
        is_plot_call = bool({"kind", "x", "y", "column"}.intersection(kwargs.keys()))

        if df is not None and hasattr(df, "to_pandas") and not isinstance(df, (str, list, tuple)):
            df = df.to_pandas()

        if (
            not kwargs.get("_is_facet_grid")
            and isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame)
            and by_col is not None
            and by_col in df
            and has_facet_trigger
            and is_plot_call
        ):
            if "mosaic" in kwargs or (len(args) > 1 and args[1] is not None):
                raise ValueError("Cannot combine 'mosaic' with faceting ('by' with 'ncols'/'facet'/'col').")
            if "nrows" in kwargs:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Cannot combine 'nrows' with faceting ('by' with 'ncols'/'facet'/'col'). Use 'ncols' to control grid columns."
                )

            facet_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
            facet_kwargs.pop("df", None)
            facet_kwargs.pop("by", None)
            facet_kwargs.pop("col", None)
            facet_kwargs.pop("facet", None)
            ncols = facet_kwargs.pop("ncols", None)
            return cls.facet(df, by=by_col, ncols=ncols, **facet_kwargs)

        return super().__new__(cls)

    def __init__(
        self, df=None, mosaic=None, figsize=None, sharex=False, sharey=False, nrows=None, ncols=None, **kwargs
    ):
        _check_no_aggregation(kwargs)
        if getattr(self, "_initialized", False):
            return
        self._initialized = True
        Plotter._last_active = self
        if df is not None and hasattr(df, "to_pandas") and not isinstance(df, (str, list, tuple)):
            df = df.to_pandas()
        if df is not None and not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
            # df was passed as mosaic string or grid list e.g. Plotter("AB")
            if mosaic is None:
                mosaic = df
                df = None

        if mosaic is None and (nrows is not None or ncols is not None):
            nrows = nrows or 1
            ncols = ncols or 1
            import string

            labels = string.ascii_uppercase
            grid = []
            idx = 0
            for r in range(nrows):
                row = []
                for c in range(ncols):
                    label = labels[idx] if idx < len(labels) else f"ax_{idx}"
                    row.append(label)
                    idx += 1
                grid.append(row)
            mosaic = grid

        if mosaic is None:  # If not provided, a single axis labeled 'A' is created. 'on' is optional in this case
            mosaic = """
            A
            """
        self.fig, self.axd = plt.subplot_mosaic(mosaic=mosaic, figsize=figsize, sharex=sharex, sharey=sharey)

        self.last_kwargs = {}
        self.df = None
        self.plot_kwargs_store = {}
        self.tables = {}
        if df is not None:
            self.data(df)
        plt.close()

        plot_keys = {"kind", "x", "y", "column"}
        plot_kwargs = {k: v for k, v in kwargs.items() if k != "_is_facet_grid"}
        if plot_keys.intersection(plot_kwargs.keys()):
            if self.df is not None:
                self.plot(**plot_kwargs)
        elif plot_kwargs:
            unexpected = ", ".join(repr(k) for k in plot_kwargs.keys())
            raise TypeError(f"Plotter.__init__() got unexpected keyword argument(s): {unexpected}")

    def _repr_png_(self):
        """Render figure as PNG bytes for automatic display in Jupyter notebooks."""
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        self.fig.savefig(buf, format="png", bbox_inches="tight")
        return buf.getvalue()

    @property
    def pt(self):
        """Allow consistent fluent chaining using the .pt namespace (e.g. df.pt.plot().pt.finalize())."""
        return self

    def data(self, df):
        Plotter._last_active = self
        if df is not None and hasattr(df, "to_pandas") and not isinstance(df, (str, list, tuple)):
            df = df.to_pandas()
        self.df = df
        self.last_kwargs = {}  # Reset kwargs when new data is chained!
        return self

    def get_data(self, on="A"):
        """Retrieve the DataFrame plotted on the specified axis key."""
        if on in self.tables:
            return self.tables[on]
        for k, v in self.tables.items():
            if k == on or k.rstrip("^") == on:
                return v
        raise KeyError(f"No plotted data found for axis {on!r}; available: {list(self.tables)}")

    @classmethod
    def facet(
        cls, df, by, *, ncols=None, sort=True, titles=True, figsize=None, sharex=False, sharey=False, **plot_kwargs
    ):
        """Build a small-multiples grid, one axis per distinct value of `by`, and plot
        the same chart (**plot_kwargs, e.g. x=/y=/kind=) on each facet's own subset of
        rows. A grid isn't always exactly fillable (e.g. 5 groups doesn't tile a 2x3
        rectangle) -- the leftover cell(s) are left blank rather than turned into
        empty/unused axes.

        Parameters:
        -----------
        df : pd.DataFrame
            The data to facet.
        by : str
            Column whose distinct values become one facet (axis) each.
        ncols : int, optional
            Columns in the grid. Defaults to a roughly square layout (ceil(sqrt(n))).
        sort : bool, optional
            Sort group values (default True). Ignored for a `category` dtype column,
            which always uses its own defined category order.
        titles : bool, optional
            Set each facet's axis title to its group value (default True).
        figsize :
            Passed straight through to the underlying Plotter().
        sharex, sharey : bool, optional
            Share x or y axis scales across facets (default False).
        **plot_kwargs :
            Passed straight through to .plot() for every facet, e.g. x=, y=, kind=.

        Returns:
        --------
        Plotter
            A regular Plotter instance (chain `.finalize()` etc. as usual); `.axd` is
            keyed by the stringified group values, e.g. `plotter.axd['Adelie']`.
        """
        _check_no_aggregation(plot_kwargs)
        if isinstance(df[by].dtype, pd.CategoricalDtype):
            present = set(df[by].dropna().unique())
            groups = [g for g in df[by].cat.categories if g in present]
        else:
            groups = list(pd.unique(df[by].dropna()))
            if sort:
                groups = sorted(groups)
        if not groups:
            raise ValueError(f"facet: no groups found in column '{by}'")

        keys = [str(g) for g in groups]
        if len(set(keys)) != len(keys):
            raise ValueError(f"facet: group values in '{by}' produce duplicate axis keys once stringified: {keys}")

        if ncols is not None and ncols < 1:
            raise ValueError(f"facet: ncols must be at least 1, got {ncols}")
        ncols = ncols or math.ceil(math.sqrt(len(groups)))
        nrows = math.ceil(len(groups) / ncols)
        cells = keys + ["."] * (nrows * ncols - len(keys))  # pad leftover cells blank -- grid may not tile exactly
        grid = [cells[i : i + ncols] for i in range(0, len(cells), ncols)]

        plot_kwargs = dict(plot_kwargs)
        if "mosaic" in plot_kwargs:
            raise ValueError("Cannot combine 'mosaic' with faceting. Faceting generates its own layout grid.")
        if "nrows" in plot_kwargs:
            raise ValueError("Cannot combine 'nrows' with faceting. Use 'ncols' to control grid columns.")
        plot_kwargs.pop("mosaic", None)
        plot_kwargs.pop("nrows", None)
        plot_kwargs.pop("on", None)
        suptitle = plot_kwargs.pop("suptitle", None) or plot_kwargs.pop("title", None)
        plotter = cls(mosaic=grid, figsize=figsize, sharex=sharex, sharey=sharey, _is_facet_grid=True)
        for group, key in zip(groups, keys):
            plotter.data(df[df[by] == group]).plot(on=key, **plot_kwargs)
            if titles:
                plotter.axd[key].set_title(str(group))
        if suptitle:
            plotter.fig.suptitle(str(suptitle))
        plotter.df = df  # restore the full input frame -- each facet call above narrowed it to one group
        plotter._initialized = True
        Plotter._last_active = plotter
        return plotter

    def plot(self, **kwargs):
        Plotter._last_active = self
        self._update_kwargs(kwargs)
        self._validate_required_kwargs()
        ax = self._get_target_axis()

        if self.kind == "scatter":
            self._plot_scatter(ax)
